examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Pass ancestors first and the current page last. Ancestors are native links; the last item is a noninteractive `aria-current="page"` label.

examples.title: With icons
examples.description: Add an `icon` to any item. Keep decorative icons hidden from assistive technology so the text remains the accessible name.

examples.title: Hidden pages
examples.description: `maxItems` defaults to 4, counting the overflow button. Middle ancestors remain in a keyboard-accessible menu. Enter opens it, arrows move between pages, and Escape restores focus.

examples.title: Long labels
examples.description: Opt in to `maxItemWidth` to shorten each label visually. Full text remains in the accessible name and the native title. The path still scrolls horizontally in a narrow container.

examples.title: Custom separator
examples.description: Use `separator` for a decorative slash, dot or icon. Separators are hidden from assistive technology.

examples.title: Right to left
examples.description: Set `dir="rtl"` to reverse the path direction. The default chevrons mirror and the overflow menu follows the same direction.

examples.title: Navigate a local hierarchy
examples.description: `onNavigate` receives the original item, index and mouse event, including pages in the overflow menu. Prevent the default when your app owns navigation. New levels slide in softly; reduced motion keeps them still.
